newsitem.title: UK: Millennium & Copthorne makes John O'Shea MD.
newsitem.headline: Millennium & Copthorne makes John O'Shea MD.

text.p: Millennium & Copthorne Hotels Plc said on Wednesday that it had appointed John O'Shea as managing director with effect from July 21.

O'Shea has had wide international experience as a hotel executive, having held senior positions at Inter-Continental Hotels, Shangri-La Hotels and Resorts, and recently at CDL Hotels International Ltd.
"This appointment will broaden and strengthen Millennium & Copthorne's executive team as we strive to maximise earnings and shareholders' returns," said chairman Kwek Leng Beng in a statement.
